Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's it from this game! Bangladesh have roared back and it's all square in this 3-match T20I series. The all-important series decider is up next. The third and final T20I will be played on Tuesday, 2nd August. The action is all set to begin at 4.30 pm IST (11.00 am GMT). But as you all know our build-up will begin in advance. So do join us then. For now, it's goodbye!

Nurul Hasan the skipper of Bangladesh says that it was a great performance from the team. Mosaddek Hossain started well with the ball and Litton Das set the tone with the bat. Adds that they would have bowled first had they won the toss. Concludes by saying that they will do well in the next game and try to win that one as well.

The vice-captain of Zimbabwe, Regis Chakabva says that they got themselves in trouble at the start and lost too many wickets early. Credits Sikandar Raza and Ryan Burl for pulling them out of trouble. Admits that the wicket is still very good for batting but they found themselves losing too many wickets. Continues mentioning Sikandar Raza and says that he has been brilliant in the recent past and they need to apply themselves to get out of difficult situations. On Craig Ervine's injury, he says that he will be fine.

Mosaddek Hossain is the Player of the Match for career-best figures of 5 for 20. He says that he is feeling fantastic about his figures. Adds that they had planned in advance about starting with the spinner so he was well aware of his role. Mentions that they did not talk much about the loss they just knew they can play well and win this game.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier, Bangladesh came back to the game really strong with the ball. After being brutally assaulted in the first game, they had Zimbabwe pegged back right from the start. Mosaddek Hossain was the star with the ball delivering his four overs right at the start of the innings and dismissing half of the Zimbabwe side. Sikandar Raza continued his good form and got his team to a respectable total with his half-century but it was all for nothing.

Zimbabwe have been brought back to earth after following a dominating win with a humiliating defeat. Eight bowlers were used as they just did not have enough to defend. The part-time bowlers bowled well and chipped in with a couple of wickets but overall they would have been hoping that they had a decent total to bowl at and make this game a contest. They had pretty much lost the game in the first innings.

This run chase has been an absolute walk in the park for Bangladesh, losing just 3 wickets and getting to the target with 15 deliveries to spare. They lost Munim Shahriar early but Litton Das was accumulating runs with ease en route to his half-century. He departed soon after reaching the landmark ending a 41-run partnership with Anamul Haque who was dismissed shortly after. Najmul Hossain Shanto and Afif Hossain then took Bangladesh home with an unbeaten partnership of 55 runs to square things up.

What a comeback this has been from Bangladesh! After a loss in the first T20I, they have put on an absolutely dominating performance to beat Zimbabwe by 7 wickets in this second game and have now leveled the series! Now there is all to play for in the final game at the same venue as that will decide who takes this series.
Pitches it up, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto drives it towards mid on and takes a single. Bangladesh win by 7 wickets and level the series!
Wide! Full in length, very wide this time. Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves it alone. Wide called! Scores are now level!
Swing and a miss! Slower this time, full and wide of off again. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to slash this one away but he misses.
Fuller ball, wide of off. Najmul Hossain Shanto squeezes it out towards the fielder at point. A dot to begin with!
Tighter line! Around the off pole, a length ball. Afif Hossain stays in his crease and taps it towards point. 2 needed off 18 balls!
On a length now, around middle and leg. Afif Hossain blocks it out solidly.
FOUR! Up and over! Pitches it up, outside off. Afif Hossain drives it uppishly over mid off for a boundary. That brings up the 50-run stand between these two!
A low full toss, angling in on the pads. Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it towards deep square leg. Three runs taken! Bangladesh are one big hit away now!
Slight halt in play as the physio makes his way out to the middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks alright here but requires the mandatory concussion check. That is done and we are set to resume.

FOUR LEG BYES! Richard Ngarava drops it short again, pace on this time, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to pull this but he misses. The ball hits his helmet and rolls away towards third man for a boundary.
Slightly short again, outside off. Afif Hossain gets on his toes and taps it towards cover and takes a quick single.
Wide! A shorter one, down the leg side. Afif Hossain looks to pull this one but he misses. Wide given!
Angling in, on a length, around the thigh pad. Afif Hossain tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single. Bangladesh are 15 runs away!
Wide! A full toss wide of off. Afif Hossain leaves it alone. Wide called!
On a length now, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Make that four singles! Slower ball, short and outside off. Afif Hossain pulls it gently towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
A full toss, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto drives it towards deep cover. Third single on the trot!
Back of a length, around off. Afif Hossain pulls it towards deep square leg. Single taken!
Luke Jongwe begins with a length ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Around the leg pole, full again. Afif Hossain misses his tuck and gets hit on his pads. Bangladesh needs 22 runs more off 30 balls.
Shorter one, drifting in, around middle. Afif Hossain looks to flick this one but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. Two taken!
Tad quicker, around middle, fuller in length. Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it towards long on and takes a single.
Slower this time, full and outside off. Afif Hossain drives it wide of mid off for a single.
Pitches it up again, on the pads. Afif Hossain tucks it towards mid-wicket.
SIX! Bang! A fuller ball, around middle. Afif Hossain shimmies down the track and heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Bangladesh are 26 runs away now!
This is full and angled into the batter, Afif Hossain chips the ball in the air towards long on for a single.

Sikandar Raza goes short and wide outside off, Afif Hossain stays back and gets low to cut this late past the keeper's gloves towards the fine third man fence. They get two runs as the fielder cuts this off.
This is flighted full outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto strokes this towards long off for a single.
This is full and in line with the stumps. Najmul Hossain Shanto gets down the wicket and fends the ball back to the bowler.
Goes full outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto fends this to the right of the diving bowler.
FOUR! Boundary to start the over! Sikandar Raza angles this ball down leg on a fuller length. Najmul Hossain Shanto sweeps this fine past the fielder towards the fine leg boundary for four runs!
Pitches it up, around middle. Afif Hossain pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter and quicker, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Fuller, outside off. Afif Hossain dabs it towards point and takes a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Afif Hossain pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter ball, around off. Afif Hossain cuts it towards cover.

Misfield allows the batters to take four runs! Fuller ball, on the pads. Afif Hossain glances it towards short fine leg. Richard Ngarava there misfields and the ball rolls away towards the ropes. He does well, in the end, to keep the ball away from the ropes, but the batters run 4 anyway.
This one is fired quick into the pads, Afif Hossain clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
Najmul Hossain Shanto comes down the wicket and catches the ball on the full and work it to lon on for a run.
This is flighted full and wide outside off, Afif Hossain knocks this towards long off for a single.
Flights this one full and on middle stump line, Najmul Hossain Shanto works this to long on for a single.
This one is angled down leg and full, Najmul Hossain Shanto guides this straight to short fine leg.
Sikandar Raza goes full and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to play at this and gets an inside edge to backward square leg. They go for a single and an overthrow allows another run.
This is full and attacking the stumps. Knocked down to long on for another single. Great over to start of as just 2 runs come off it.
Flights this once again full outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto shimmies down the wicket taps this towards mid-wicket.
A fraction quicker served full outside off, Afif Hossain knocks this down to long on for a single.
Goes full once again and on an off stump line, Afif Hossain defends this towards cover.
Tossed up full once again and outside off, Afif Hossain fends this towards cover.
Wesley Madhevere begins with a full delivery flighted on middle, Afif Hossain fends this towards mid on.
Flatter and straighter, full in length now. Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Tad shorter, around off. Afif Hossain cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Straighter, fuller in length. Afif Hossain blocks it out.
Najmul Hossain Shanto walks out to the middle. Two new batters at the crease now.

OUT! TAKEN! Wickets in quick succession for Zimbabwe! It's Sikandar Raza who sends back Anamul Haque. Cannot keep this man away from the game! A fuller one, around off. Anamul Haque gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg. The ball goes off the top edge and flies straight to the fielder there, Wellington Masakadza there takes a good catch. Bangladesh have lost their third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Wellington Masakadza b Sikandar Raza

Commentary.Commentary: Pitches it up, around middle and off. Afif Hossain drives it down to long off for a single. He gets off the mark!
Wide! Sikandar Raza errs in line and serves it down the leg side. Wide called!
Sikandar Raza begins with a quicker one, around middle and leg. Anamul Haque flicks it off the back foot towards square leg for a single.
Afif Hossain is the new man at the crease. Sikandar Raza has been brought into the attack.

OUT! LBW! Sean Williams gets rid of Litton Das! A big wicket for Zimbabwe! But he has done all the damage here! A fuller ball, loopy one, around middle and leg. Litton Das gets down on his knee and looks to sweep this but he misses and gets hit on his pads. A loud appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger! Litton Das is not happy with that decision, but he has to walk back!
Fuller now, around off. Anamul Haque steps down the pitch and knocks it down to long off. Single taken!
Back of a length, around off. Litton Das exposes all his stumps and cuts it towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Cut away! Shorter one, outside off. Litton Das rocks back and slashes this one past point for a boundary. Bangladesh are cruising along!
Another fuller ball, outside off. Anamul Haque pushes it towards cover. The fielder there has a shy at the keeper's end but it well away. The fielder backing up dives and makes a good stop.
Fuller ball, around the pads. Anamul Haque steps down the pitch and pushes it towards mid-wicket. No run there!

FOUR! Litton Das brings up his fifty in style! A shorter ball, around off. Litton Das uses the depth of his crease and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. It's been an excellent knock from him!
Tosses this one up, full, around off. Litton Das pushes this one to cover.
Fuller one, on the pads. Litton Das presses forward and taps it towards mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs!
Shorter ball, on the stumps, quick as well. Anamul Haque pulls it towards mid-wicket. Only a single taken!
Angling in, quick again, around middle. Litton Das flicks it off the back foot towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Litton Das greets Ryan Burl with a boundary! A quicker one, shorter and outside off. Litton Das uses the depth of his crease and cuts it late past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Ryan Burl is introduced into the attack.
This one is fired in quick on an off stump line, Anamul Haque fends this towards the cover fielder.
Short delivery outside off, Litton Das pulls and drags the ball towards deep mid-wicket for one more run.
Sean Williams continues bowling short and into the stumps, Anamul Haque pulls this towards deep sqaure leg for an easy run.
This is short and angled into the pads, Litton Das pulls this towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Fraction short and outside off, Litton Das hits this hard towards long on and a misfield allows them to take a couple of runs.
Sean Williams begins with a fuller ball, angling in, around the pads. Anamul Haque clips it towards square leg for a single.
Full and much straighter now. Anamul Haque tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. Bangladesh are 53 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay!
FOUR! Up and over! Lovely shot! Another loopy one, full and around off. Anamul Haque makes room and drives it over cover for another boundary in the over! 50 up for Bangladesh!
Tosses this one up, full, around the leg pole. Anamul Haque looks to sweep this one but he misses and gets hit on his pads. An apple there for LBW, but the umpire says no! Probably sliding down leg.
Tighter line now! Around the off pole, fullish ball. Anamul Haque taps it towards cover.
Fuller now and on the pads. Litton Das flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! A shorter ball, outside off. Litton Das rocks back and slashes it past point for a boundary.
This one is short as well and pitching in line with the leg stump, Litton Das clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
Richard Ngarava bangs this in short and into the batter, Anamul Haque looks to pull and mistime the ball to the left of short fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Richard Ngarava bowls a low full toss in line with the stumps Anamul Haque first up. he gets his bat down and plays this to the left of short fine leg as the ball runs away to the deep backward square leg fence. Anamul Haque is off the mark.
Anamul Haque walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Richard Ngarava draws first blood! Munim Shahriar never really got going and has to depart! Richard Ngarava serves this on a good length and attacks the top of the off pole. Munim Shahriar looks to pull this leg side but the ball is not short enough. He misses the line of the ball as it goes on to shatter the stumps! Zimbabwe have the wicket and will be looking to capitalize.
This is on a good length and outside off, Litton Das plays this with soft hands towards point and rushes across for a run.

FOUR! Litton Das is looking good here! Regis Chakabva goes full outside off and gives Litton Das room to lift this ball over the infield towards the deep cover fence for four more runs. Litton Das wants to reach this target in a hurry!
Change of ends for Richard Ngarava!
Short once again and this time wide outside off, Litton Das cuts this to the left of point and rushes across for a single as the fielder makes a good stop.
Short delivery angled into the batter, Munim Shahriar shimmies down the wicket and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Munim Shahriar fends this back towards the bowler.
Short this time and wide outside off, Munim Shahriar slashes at this and finds the point fielder.
Wellington Masakadza serves this full outside off, Litton Das taps this down to long on for a single.
Tad fuller, drifting in on the pads. Litton Das flicks it through square leg. Two taken!

Direct hit..but Munim Shahriar was in! A fuller ball, around off. Litton Das taps it towards cover and sets off for a single. The fielder there scores a direct hit at the keeper's end but Munim Shahriar dives in to make his ground. Single taken! 17 runs off the over!
Much better from Tanaka Chivanga! Fuller and around off. Litton Das drives and finds the fielder at cover.
SIX! Oh, this is poor bowling from Tanaka Chivanga! This is his fourth short ball, around off. Litton Das pulls it this one over mid-wicket and all the way for a maximum!
FOUR! This time it's from the middle of the bat! Drops it short once again, around middle. Litton Das swivels and pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
EDGED AND SIX! Another short ball, around off. Litton Das goes for the pull again, but he manages to get a top edge over the keeper's head and all the way for a biggie!
Tanaka Chivanga begins with a shorter ball, down the leg side. Litton Das looks to pull this but the ball goes off the inner half and towards the fielder at square leg.
Tanaka Chivanga comes into the attack.

Regis Chakabva bowling good length here as this one bounces off the surface. Munim Shahriar hangs his bat outside off and gets beaten all ends up. Good over from Richard Ngarava as he concedes just 3 runs from his first.
Richard Ngarava pulls his length back and bit and tucks the batter for space. Litton Das taps this down to the leg side for a quick single.
Richard Ngarava bowls a low full toss on the pads, Munim Shahriar clips this through mid-wicket for a run.
Fraction short once again and on leg, Litton Das flicks this towards backward square leg for a single.
This one is on a good length as well and pitching on middle and leg. Litton Das fends this back down the pitch.
Richard Ngarava begins with a good-length delivery angling away from the batter. Litton Das pushes at it and gets beaten on the outside edge.

FOUR! First boundary for Bangladesh! Munim Shahriar serves this short and wide outside off, Munim Shahriar frees his arms and slashes at this to get it past the diving point fielder for a boundary to deep backward point!
This is short as well and angled  into the pads, Litton Das goes on the back foot and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls this a fraction short and angling into the stumps, Litton Das fends this back down the pitch.
This is fired in full into the pads, Munim Shahriar gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for a run.
Much better from Wellington Masakadza as this is full and in line with the stumps, Litton Das works this towards long on for a single.
Wellington Masakadza begins with a half-tracker wide outside off, Litton Das misses out as he hits this straight towards the cover fielder.
